meta.title: Can playing video games help you get a better job?

paragraphs.text: The gaming industry is larger than films and music combined, yet few of us are likely to list our achievements in playing computer games as work experience in our résumé. But why not? Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace.

sentences.text: But why not?

analysis.translationLiteral: 但为什么不呢？
analysis.translationNatural: 可那为什么不呢？
analysis.structMarkup: (But) (why) _not_?
analysis.structureSummary: 省略反问句（But + why + not）

components.note: 转折连词，承接上句「几乎没人写」，提出反问
疑问副词，问原因

clauses: 本句为疑问句；一般疑问句把助动词/系动词提前，特殊疑问句用疑问词开头。

phrases.meaning: 本句核心表达
phrases.usage: 本句主干为「省略反问句（But + why + not）」。

analysis.paragraphRole: 用一句短反问把读者的疑虑抛回，顺势引出下句企业的态度转变。

analysis.paragraphRole: 以 Businesses are waking up 正面回答上句反问，明确「游戏技能适用于工作」，对应第 39 题。

And Game Academy reckons its belief is backed up by hard data. Do you enjoy unusual puzzle games like Portal, or tower defence games like Defense Grid? The team has found that IT workers play those more than average. But if you prefer Civilization, Total War, or X-Com, where strategy and resource management are key, then you might have more in common with managers.

clauses: 本句为疑问句；一般疑问句把助动词/系动词提前，特殊疑问句用疑问词开头。

phrases.meaning: 享受…的乐趣、喜爱；享有（某种条件）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：enjoy doing（喜欢做，接动名词，不接 to do）/ enjoy oneself（玩得开心）/ enjoy sth（享有，如 enjoy good health）/ enjoyment（乐趣，名词）/ enjoy 与 like（like to do / doing 均可，enjoy 只接 doing）。

sentences.text: The team has found that IT workers play those more than average.

analysis.translationLiteral: 该团队已经发现 IT 工作者玩那些多于平均水平。
analysis.translationNatural: 团队发现，IT 从业者玩这类游戏的频率高于平均。

components.note: 回指 Game Academy 团队
现在完成时

components.part: that IT workers play those more than average

phrases.usage: 常见搭配：a team of researchers。

phrases.meaning: find 的过去式与过去分词（发现）；另作独立动词「创建、创办」

paragraphs.text: Twelve years into his career, Mark Long, a radiotherapy physicist with the NHS in Surrey, doesn't get as much gaming time as he used to. "I would love to say that my gaming skills allow me to destroy cancer using linear accelerators like photon(光子) blasters, but that's not quite the reality." Instead, he credits old-school games like Palace of Magic with exposing him to computers. Every new gaming upgrade improved his knowledge of how they worked. Gaming also encouraged a competitive spirit — and that, he believes, translates. "When creating treatment plans, the aim is to optimise the radiation dose to the tumour and restrict it as much as possible to healthy surrounding tissues and organs," he says. It's about "repeating the process, but each time doing something slightly different to improve the result". Not unlike achieving a high score or a perfect run. "Most videogames are essentially puzzles to solve," he says. "And problem-solving is a big part of my job."

examples: But part of Game Academy's suggestion is to transform casual gamers into "conscious" ones, applying critical thinking to developing their skills. 但 Game Academy 的建议之一，是把随便玩玩的玩家变成「有自觉」的玩家，用批判性思维去提升他们的技能。

true.sense: 真实的；真正的；符合事实的
examples: This is true in education too. 这在教育上也成立。

more.confusables: true（真实的）/ truth（名词）/ real（真实的，指非虚构）

examples: Stanford University scholars studied the data. 斯坦福大学的学者研究了这些数据。

more.confusables: university（大学）/ college（学院）/ at university（在读大学，不加 the）

unlike.sense: 不像、和…不同、与…相反；不同的、不相似的

more.roots: un-（否定/相反前缀）+ like（像，介词）
more.confusables: unlike（介词「不像、与…不同」，后接名词）/ dislike（动词「不喜欢」，及物）/ unlikely（形容词「不太可能的」，be unlikely to do）/ alike（相像的，常作表语）/ different from（近义）

examples: Not unlike achieving a high score or a perfect run. 这其实跟游戏里刷高分、打出完美通关没什么两样。

unlikely.sense: 不像、和…不同、与…相反；不同的、不相似的（unlike 的副词形式）
examples: Playing games casually is unlikely to help your career prospects. 随便玩玩游戏，不太可能帮到你的职业前途。

more.confusables: unlikely（副词）/ unlike（原形）

examples: Do you enjoy unusual puzzle games like Portal, or tower defence games like Defense Grid? 你是喜欢 Portal 这类特别的解谜游戏，还是 Defense Grid 这类塔防游戏？

used.sense: use 的过去式/过去分词；（be used to）习惯于；（used to）过去常常
examples: They used flexible work arrangements. 他们使用了弹性工作安排。

more.confusables: used to do（过去常常）/ be used to doing（习惯于）/ be used to do（被用来做）

useful.sense: 有用的、有益的、实用的（be useful for/to；反义 useless）
examples: But "For now, I think the negative reputation around games means that telling someone you're a determined gamer is more likely to harm your chances of getting a job. But if someone can explain how they've led a team in an online game, for example, they may be able to persuade an employer that this is useful," says Dr Barr. 不过「眼下，我觉得游戏那负面名声意味着：告诉别人你是个铁杆玩家，反而更可能坏事、让你更难找工作。可要是有人能说清自己怎么在网游里带过队，比如，他或许就能说服雇主这经历有用，」Barr 博士说。

more.confusables: useful / usefully（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

examples: Results improve by using existing technology. 使用现有技术就能改善结果。

more.confusables: using（现在分词）/ used（过去式/过去分词）

examples: That was a valuable lesson. 那是宝贵的一课。

more.roots: valuable 含 -able / -ible（形容词后缀，表「可……的」）

variety.sense: 多样性、变化、多样化；种类、品种（a variety of 各种各样的）

more.confusables: a variety of + 复数可数名词（各种各样的，谓语通常用复数）/ the variety of（…的种类/多样性，谓语用单数）/ varieties of（多种…）/ variation（变化、变体）/ vary（动词）/ various（形容词）

examples: Those skills are part of what the Royal Air Force is looking for "in a variety of roles". 这些本事，正是皇家空军在「各类岗位」上求之不得的。

vehicle.sense: 车辆、交通工具、机动车；（喻）载体、媒介、手段（self-driving vehicles 自动驾驶汽车）
examples: He restructured Zentech, once a taxation vehicle for his father's business, and it is now in its fourth year helping international brands enter the Canadian market. 他重组了 Zentech——那原本是他父亲生意的避税壳子——如今已进入第四年，帮国际品牌打入加拿大市场。

more.confusables: vehicle / vehicles（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

waking.sense: 醒来；唤醒；唤起（wake 的现在分词/动名词形式）
examples: Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace. 企业正开始意识到，玩家能把这些技能带进职场。

more.confusables: waking（现在分词/动名词）/ wake（原形）

want.sense: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要
examples: They want to appear more adult. 他们想显得更成熟。

more.confusables: want to do（想要）/ need to do（需要）/ would like to do（更礼貌）

war.sense: 战争、战争状态、斗争、竞争、对抗
examples: But if you prefer Civilization, Total War, or X-Com, where strategy and resource management are key, then you might have more in common with managers. 可要是你偏爱 Civilization、Total War 或 X-Com 这类游戏——策略和资源管理是核心——那你也许更像管理者。

more.confusables: war / warned / warming（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

waste.sense: 浪费、滥用、废料、垃圾、荒地；浪费、白费、未充分利用；废弃的、荒芜的
examples: Digital entrepreneur and business consultant Mia Bennett says: "In more traditional settings, gaming is still imagined to be the pursuit of teenage boys — a waste of time." 数字企业家兼商业顾问 Mia Bennett 说：「在更传统的眼光里，游戏仍被看作男孩子的消遣——纯属浪费时间。」

work.sense: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品
examples: The approach works in practice. 这个方法在实践中奏效。

more.confusables: work（工作，不可数）/ job（职位，可数）/ works（工厂；作品）

worked.sense: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品（work 的过去式/过去分词形式）
examples: Every new gaming upgrade improved his knowledge of how they worked. 每一次游戏更新，都让他更懂它们是怎么运作的。

more.confusables: worked（过去式/过去分词）/ work（原形）

workers.sense: 工人、劳动者、工作者、员工（worker 的复数）

more.confusables: worker（工人、工作者，可数）/ employee（雇员，强调雇佣关系）/ workforce（全体劳动力，集合）/ work（工作，不可数；也作动词）/ job（可数，work 不可数）

examples: The team has found that IT workers play those more than average. 团队发现，IT 从业者玩这类游戏的频率高于平均。

workplace.sense: 工作场所、职场、办公室（in the workplace 在职场）

more.roots: work（工作）+ place（场所）构成的复合名词，意为「工作场所」
more.confusables: workplace（工作场所，可数，in the workplace）/ workspace（工作空间/工位）/ workday（工作日）/ office（办公室）

examples: Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace. 企业正开始意识到，玩家能把这些技能带进职场。
The idea spread around the world. 这个想法传遍世界。

more.confusables: world（世界）/ word（单词）读音与拼写易混

writing.sense: 写作、文字（不可数）；write 的现在分词
examples: Teaching formal writing is still crucial. 教正式写作仍然关键。

more.confusables: writing（写作）/ written（过去分词）

examples: Red Rum returned the very next year. 「红朗姆」在第二年又回来了。

more.confusables: year（年）/ ear（耳朵）

years.sense: 年、年份；岁数、年纪（year 的复数）

more.confusables: year（年，可数）/ for years（好多年，与完成时连用）/ in a year's time（一年后）/ a five-year-old（复合词中 year 不用复数）/ ear（耳朵，拼写易混）

examples: One start-up is convinced that the skills learned by playing games — hard-won through years of training and battle — can be applied to real-life work situations. 有家初创公司坚信：打游戏练出来的、靠多年磨炼辛苦得来的那些技能，完全能用到现实工作里。

yet.sense: 尚、还（否定/疑问句）；然而（连词）
examples: Yet studies suggest these anxieties are misplaced. 然而研究表明这些焦虑没有根据。

more.confusables: yet（尚/然而）/ already（已经）/ but（但是）
